Get or update the properties of a SharePoint file or folder

Source: R/sp_item.R
sp_item_properties.Rd

get_sp_item_properties() gets the properties of a file or folder, such as the name, size, and creation date. Set fields = TRUE to also get the values of the document library columns (fields) for the item. To get the fields for many items, use get_sp_list() to get the document library as a list and use list_sp_list_items() or get_sp_list_item() instead.

update_sp_item_properties() renames a file or folder or updates the values of document library columns for the item. Field values are updated with update_sp_list_item() using the list for the document library, so the same field name checks and formatting (e.g. for multi-choice columns) are used. To move an item to another folder, use sp_item_move() instead.

Usage

get_sp_item_properties(
  path = NULL,
  item_id = NULL,
  item_url = NULL,
  ...,
  drive = NULL,
  drive_name = NULL,
  drive_id = NULL,
  site_url = NULL,
  fields = FALSE,
  as_data_frame = FALSE,
  call = caller_env()
)

update_sp_item_properties(
  path = NULL,
  ...,
  .data = NULL,
  name = NULL,
  item_id = NULL,
  item_url = NULL,
  item = NULL,
  check_fields = TRUE,
  na_fields = c("drop", "replace"),
  drive_name = NULL,
  drive_id = NULL,
  drive = NULL,
  site_url = NULL,
  fields = FALSE,
  as_data_frame = FALSE,
  call = caller_env()
)

Arguments

path

A SharePoint file URL or the relative path to a file located in a SharePoint drive. If input is a relative path, the string should not include the drive name. If input is a shared file URL, the text "Shared " is removed from the start of the SharePoint drive name by default. If file is a document URL, the default_drive_name argument is used as the drive_name and the item_id is extracted from the URL.

item_id

A SharePoint item ID passed to the itemid parameter of the get_item method for ms_drive objects.

item_url

A SharePoint item URL used to parse the item ID, drive name, and site URL.

...

For get_sp_item_properties(), additional parameters passed to get_sp_drive(). For update_sp_item_properties(), named field values to update, e.g. Title = "Annual report". Names can be column names or display names. Ignored if .data is supplied.

drive

A ms_drive object. If drive is supplied, drive_name, site_url, and any additional parameters passed to ... are ignored.

drive_name, drive_id

SharePoint drive name or ID.

site_url

A SharePoint site URL in the format "https://[tenant name].sharepoint.com/sites/[site name]". Any SharePoint item or document URL can also be parsed to build a site URL using the tenant and site name included in the URL.

fields

If TRUE, add a fields element with the document library column values for the item (a named list). The id field is the list item id (not the drive item id). If as_data_frame = TRUE, fields is a list column with a 1 row data frame of the field values (use tidyr::unnest(data, fields, names_sep = "_") to add the fields as columns). Defaults to FALSE. Fields are only available for items in a SharePoint document library.

as_data_frame

If TRUE, return a 1 row data frame. If FALSE (default), return a list of item properties.

call

The execution environment of a currently running function, e.g. caller_env(). The function will be mentioned in error messages as the source of the error. See the call argument of abort() for more information.

.data

A named list or a single row data frame with field values to update. Optional.

name

A new name for the item. Optional. name must not include a folder path. An error is returned if an item with the same name already exists in the folder.

item

A ms_drive_item object. If item is supplied, path, item_id, item_url, and the drive arguments are ignored.

check_fields

If TRUE (default), column names (or record field names) for the input data are matched to the fields of the list object. If FALSE, names aren't checked and the Graph API errors for any name that isn't a list field.

na_fields

How to handle NA fields in input data. One of "drop" (remove NA and empty fields, e.g. a multi-select value of character(0), before updating list items, leaving existing values in place) or "replace" (overwrite existing list values with new replacement NA values or, for multi-value fields, an empty selection).

Value

A list of item properties, or a 1 row data frame if as_data_frame = TRUE. update_sp_item_properties() returns the properties after the update.

See also

get_sp_item(), get_sp_list_item()

Examples

sp_item_url <- "<SharePoint item url>"

if (is_sp_url(sp_item_url)) {
  get_sp_item_properties(sp_item_url, fields = TRUE)

  update_sp_item_properties(
    sp_item_url,
    Title = "Annual report",
    name = "annual-report-2026.docx"
  )
}
